title: Reporting a repair to property management
objectives: Identify the unit and describe the fault
Confirm the appointment and ask about cost
Ask whether you need to be present

courseTemplate.setting: The tenant is in unit 402. An electrician is available tomorrow at ten. No charge applies to the building fixture in this roleplay.

roles.learner: A tenant reporting a flickering light

courseTemplate.openingLine: Property management, good morning. How can I help?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm in unit 402. The bathroom light keeps flickering.
targetPatterns.example: I'm in unit 402. The bathroom light keeps flickering.

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, ten works. Will there be a charge?
targetPatterns.example: Yes, ten works. Will there be a charge?

targetPatterns.pattern: Do I need to be home for the appointment?
targetPatterns.example: Do I need to be home for the appointment?

targetPatterns.pattern: There's a leak under the kitchen sink.
targetPatterns.example: There's a leak under the kitchen sink.

targetPatterns.pattern: When can someone come to fix it?
targetPatterns.example: When can someone come to fix it?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is the boiler covered by maintenance?
targetPatterns.example: Is the boiler covered by maintenance?
targetPatterns.translation: 锅炉维修包含在物业里吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we discuss the rent increase?
targetPatterns.example: Could we discuss the rent increase?

targetPatterns.pattern: My neighbor's music is loud after midnight.
targetPatterns.example: My neighbor's music is loud after midnight.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like to renew the lease for another year.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like to renew the lease for another year.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I get a receipt for the rent payment?
targetPatterns.example: Could I get a receipt for the rent payment?
targetPatterns.translation: 能给我一张租金收据吗？

stages.title: Identify the unit and describe the fault
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Property management, good morning. How can I help?”
successCriteria: The learner can identify the unit and describe the fault in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm in unit 402. …”

stages.title: Confirm the appointment and ask about cost
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “We can send an electrician tomorrow at ten. Does that work?”
successCriteria: The learner can confirm the appointment and ask about cost in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, ten works. Will …”

stages.title: Ask whether you need to be present
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “There's no charge for that fixture in your unit. Is there anything else?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask whether you need to be present in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Do I need to …”

languageNotes: 「物业」是 property management，不是 "wuye"；报修描述尽量具体（位置+现象+持续时间），英美人不擅长猜。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 厨房水槽下面漏水了。
warmup.suggestedAnswer: There's a leak under the kitchen sink.

modelDialogue.text: Property management, good morning. How can I help?
I'm in unit 402. The bathroom light keeps flickering.
We can send an electrician tomorrow at ten. Does that work?
Yes, ten works. Will there be a charge?
There's no charge for that fixture in your unit. Is there anything else?
Do I need to be home for the appointment?
